title: Island Sandbox
metaDescription: Baked Island Terrain World Engine map. Warlords, Voxel, Nexus, Armada, and Game heroes share this sandbox.
markdown:
## Island Sandbox

Playable terrain is **baked** from Island Terrain World Engine (`grudge-island-bake/v1`). Default map is **Harbor Atoll**; switch with `ISLAND_MAP=volcanic-ridge` or `frozen-fjord`, or point `ISLAND_ENGINE_ROOT` at your engine export folder.

### All-era play
This is a sandbox. Character select loads **every fleet era** (4 slots each). Voxel Mixamo kits, Warlords grudge6, Nexus, Armada, and Game heroes all replicate in the same room.

### Run
```bash
GAME_SCRIPT=islandSandboxScript.ts ISLAND_MAP=harbor-atoll pnpm run dev:back
```

markdown:
## GrudgeBlox Test World

Sandbox play on **blox.grudge-studio.com**. Roster is **all eras** so Warlords, Voxel, Nexus, Armada, and Game heroes share the room.

### Stack
- 4-slot select per era + create (Railway `?era=`)
- Avatar: kit or era CDN GLB (replicated to other players)
- Portraits + hotbar: Mine-Loader Codex / `ui-icons`
- Skills: windup → active hit / projectile impact

### Controls
- WASD move · Space jump · E interact · 1–5 skills · Mouse look

title: Dope Budz Streets
metaDescription: Integrated Dope Budz Streets ECS world — all-era sandbox lots, grow routes, driving, and fights across six districts.
markdown:
## Dope Budz Streets

The primary Streets experience runs inside the GrudgeBlox ECS authority. Any fleet-era hero can enter.

- Six districts: Grove, Harbor, Neon, Mesa, Fogtown, Little Beach
- Claimable session lots with BUDZ/SOL balances and owner labels
- Timed plant and harvest cycles on grow benches
- Terminal-to-terminal jobs with BUDZ and reputation rewards
- Motor Row cars, street crews, jump pad, and weapon kits

Use the in-game **Street status**, **Owned lots**, and **Current job** controls for live server state. Session progress resets on disconnect until an owner-managed persistence service is configured.

### Controls
WASD move/drive · E enter, exit, or interact · 1–4 kits · mouse look
